neighbours.label: A word inside the proper name of a research or funding unit (Excellence Cluster, Research Centre, Strategic Award, matching gifts programme), vs the same nouns used in their ordinary sense
fire: The study was carried out at the Excellence Cluster Matter and Light in Hamburg.
She leads a team at the Priority Research Centre for Brain and Mental Health.
Funding came from the National Science Foundation Career Award and a university grant.
Scientists at the Cluster of Excellence Physics of Life in Dresden built the device.
The project received support from the European Research Council Starting Grant scheme.
He is a fellow of the Centre of Excellence for Climate Extremes in Sydney.
Staff can double their donation through the corporate matching gifts programme.
The trial was funded by the Medical Research Council Confidence in Concept fund.
quiet: The study was carried out on a cluster of small islands near Hamburg.
She leads walking tours from the centre of the old town every weekend.
He won an award at the local school fair for his drawing of a horse.
The grapes hung in a heavy cluster from the vine in the garden.
The farmer received a small grant to repair the barn roof after the storm.
The shopping centre was crowded on the Saturday before the holidays.
My aunt always gives thoughtful gifts to the children at birthdays.
They saved a little money each month in a fund for the new car.
